replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence directly shows server trusting client purchased flag; concrete free-premium attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Receipt sent to endpoint with no transaction-account binding; replay across accounts is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Receipt handling present; forged receipt accepted without store-side verification is a distinct spoofing attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Unlock endpoint in design; unauthenticated/cross-account unlock harms other customers, distinct from self-unlock."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Entitlement record granted on client flag; lack of transaction linkage prevents revocation and audit."}]}
